title: Tara Counts the Pebbles
markdown:
The whole house buzzed with party excitement, just like Tara’s. Auntie June was having a big Welcome party, and tiny fairy lights twinkled everywhere, even in the jar that was still empty and waiting. Tara’s very important job was to fill that giant glass jar with colourful pebbles for the table.

“My, what a big jar!” Auntie June said. “We’ll need a mountain of pebbles!”

Tara looked at the empty jar. “A mountain?” she wondered. “How many pebbles will fit?”

Nibble the mouse scurried by. “Hmm,” he squeaked, holding up ten paws. “Maybe… just ten pebbles!”

Auntie June chuckled. “Oh, Nibble! Ten is a start, but I think it will be more like… a hundred and fifty!” She wiggled her fingers to show a huge number.

Ten? A hundred and fifty? That was a big difference. How would they know for sure?

Tara’s eyes landed on the colourful pebbles. She remembered Auntie June counting her knitting stitches. “What if,” Tara announced, her idea sparkling, “we guess first, like Nibble and Auntie June! But then, we can count them carefully, one by one, as we put them in!”

“Count?” Nibble squeaked, his eyes gleaming. He liked things neat and tidy.

“Yes!” Tara chirped. “We’ll count each pebble, and then we’ll know exactly how many are in the jar!”

So the adventure began. Tara scooped up a blue pebble. “One!” she said, dropping it in. Clink! Nibble added a yellow one. “Two!” he squeaked. Clink! Blue, yellow, green, red, purple pebbles tumbled in. Clink! went each stone. They sang their counting song. “Forty-seven… forty-eight…” Nibble chanted. “Forty-nine!” Tara shouted, feeling very clever.

Soon the jar was full, shimmering with colour, a little mountain that had learned its own number. Tara dropped in the last tiny white pebble. “We did it!” she exclaimed. “And now we know exactly how many!”

Nibble checked his list. “We put in… two hundred and twenty-seven pebbles!” he declared.

Auntie June smiled. “That’s more than ten, Nibble, and a few more than my hundred and fifty, Tara. You’ve made a beautiful centrepiece, and you’ve discovered something wonderful about numbers.”

Tara clapped her hands. “Guessing is fun to start, but counting is how we really know! It’s like number magic!”

Nibble nodded, already sketching a pebble. “I wonder if counting helps us know other things too? Like how many blueberries are in this bowl?”

Tara grinned, her adventurer’s spirit shining. “I bet it does, Nibble! The world is full of things to count! What else shall we count together?” As the fairy lights twinkled, Tara knew counting was just the start of so many amazing discoveries.
characters: Tara (tiny tinkerer), Nibble (tidy mouse), June (welcome-party auntie)
author: StoryGen Community
